mapper.select: SELECT * FROM external_api_settings WHERE id = 'default' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_api_settings (id, api_key, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{apiKey}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE api_key = VALUES(api_key), enabled = VALUES(enabled), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
